item.label: FULLY BOOKED
item.title: Film 01 - 1:36 - TESSIE PRODUCTIONS, made by Grok
bullets: 214 years after the rich fled the dying Earth promising 'back in five minutes', a tiny brass maitre d' still sets one table every night - until a scruffy mutant pigeon walks in without a reservation.
Style: Velvet Ruin - handmade felt, velvet and brass stop-motion look. Voiced, with original score and sound design.

item.label: PRE-LOVED
item.title: Film 02 - 1:51 - TESSIE PRODUCTIONS, made by Grok
bullets: In a decaying love-booth arcade, two lonely strangers swap confessions and trade a gold tooth and a pearl for time with their 'synthetic companions' - until the clerk reveals both have been paying to talk to each other all along.
Style: Decadent Grotesque - photoreal, weird-faced humans in a neon-rotted futurist ruin, with a tango and bandoneon score, layered ambience and voiced dark-comic dialogue.

item.label: עד הגל הבא
item.title: Until the next wave - Hebrew short, 1:41
bullets: A rushing dad slows down for his 9-year-old daughter's quiet fear, and they learn to live until the next wave.
Golden Hour Realism: realistic animation with anime influence, original score

items.label: Build 33
items.title: V 1.33: fun arcade dogfights
bullets: Head-on jets rush past you, turn 180 and chase them in a slalom
Enemy jets need 2-3 missiles; enemy missiles and SAMs now really fly at you (yellow on radar), choppers in the fight
Hold LOOK BACK when a bandit is behind you, with a gentle cue instead of constant beeps
Boss is now a giant flying wing full of weapons; ship hits throw up water columns
Landing fixed: right stick direction, smooth glide slope, you help more near the end
Night flights with green NVG; new title art for every jet (tap SCENE & JET)
How-to: real HUD in portrait + landscape cockpit, live stick lab, new ?JX icon, no aliens
